lastTask: Add the first per-player MIDI export for selected songs

projectState.summary: Current branch codex/byte-midi-export-a adds the first simplest MIDI export. src/midi-export.ts writes a dependency-free Standard MIDI File type 1 with a tempo/section-marker track plus one track per active player. The export renders the selected active song through arrangeSongFormPatternEvent, shared section dynamics, deterministic expression velocity, and performed-time offsets. The engine currently has one active BPM and no tempo automation, so the MIDI file writes one static tempo meta event; timing feel is baked into note start ticks and velocities. UI adds a top-bar Export MIDI button and window.song.exportMidi() for tests/inspection. Validation: npm run build green, focused MIDI smoke green, full npm run smoke 79/79 green, npm run db:smoke green, git diff --check clean; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
